description: Standalone Vermont center collection and offline normalization with durable app receipts and explicit retained-input reuse.

acquiredManifestPath.description: Explicit verified retained acquisition; omission selects fixed native collection.

output_schema_contract.zip: Separate ZIP5 and ZIP4 with explicit missing/invalid reasons
output_schema_contract.geocode: Null latitude/longitude; deliberately jittered publisher points excluded; no business polygons
output_schema_contract.entity: Monthly center-source candidates with unknown exact reporting period, not verified current businesses or premises

redirect_policy: Fixed catalog/aggregate GET and selected SODA3 POST; no redirects, credentials or fallback. Retained mode makes no source requests.
publisher_exclusion: Native app acquisition owns data/business-sources/vt-childcare/runtime/publisher.lock across output roots until child writers drain and terminal persistence completes. Unknown locks are never stolen. Injected tests and retained offline work do not take the native publisher lock.
retry: No automatic retries or restart; preserve completed acquisition for explicit offline reuse without repulling.
checkpoint: Persist start before acquisition and verified child references after publication, including commit-boundary cancellation; terminal receipt last without overwrite.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app and child outputs. Native/injected jobs cannot borrow other jobs' children; retained mode pins explicit input. No current-source or national pointer changes.
cancellation: Cooperative 30-minute deadline and drained writers before terminal persistence and ownership release. Preserve published evidence. Forced termination or OS stalls require inspection.
retention_profile: Internal selected records, quarantine and linked app receipts; preserve source-period, address, postal, identity and geocode gaps.
